data.title: 法琳 · 迷宫深层火堆旁的毛皮相偎
data.description: 幽暗寒冷的迷宫深层营地里，篝火在石壁上投下温暖的光晕。法琳卸下法杖与厚重斗篷，与少年同裹在一张巨大的厚实兽皮毯下。金色短发轻轻贴着脸颊，法琳微微眯起金色的眼眸，将温暖的脸颊贴在对方肩窝，流露出只有最信任之人才能见到的安详与依赖。
data.action: wrapped in fur blanket, leaning head on shoulder, campfire glow
data.lighting: crackling orange campfire casting long shadows on cavern walls
data.mood: safe sanctuary deep within the dungeon
data.promptProse: Sheltered in a dungeon cavern, Falin shares a thick fur blanket beside the campfire. Firelight catches her short golden hair as she rests her cheek against the viewer's shoulder. Only the viewer's shoulder enters the frame.
data.animaCaption: Falin rests her cheek on the viewer's shoulder under a shared fur blanket; only the shoulder enters the frame.
